summative_task_script.title: Lesson 5 Summative Task — My Balance Puzzle
administration_steps: Score: puzzle + solve + equivalent = L3; plus reflection = L4.
summative_task_script.scoring_guidance: Coherent puzzle with variable (out of 3) + correct solve and check (out of 3) + 2 equivalents (out of 2) + reflection (out of 2) = 10.
